extracted.intended_audience: general newspaper readers interested in international and foreign-policy news
extracted.subtask_description: Reporting concise Associated Press-style foreign affairs stories covering diplomatic proposals, international reactions, and developments (e.g., parliamentary exchanges, peace proposals, conferences). Aimed at production of factual, neutral news copy for general readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Need for patience and restraint
rubrics_metrics.description: "The need for patience and restraint in seeking a just solution."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as the first basic principle in the World Council of Churches' recommended approach to the Formosa situation; advocates avoiding rash actions and pursuing measured diplomacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Caution against unilateral action
rubrics_metrics.description: "Caution against the risks of unilateral action."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Second of the four basic principles urged by the committee — warns nations not to take independent military or political moves that could escalate conflict.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utilize mediation and arbitration (UN and other agreed means)
rubrics_metrics.description: "The importance of utilizing to the fullest extent facilities for mediation and arbitration through the United Nations, or by such other means as are in harmony with the principles and purposes of the United Nations Charter."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Third principle: preference for negotiated settlements using international institutions and agreed dispute-resolution mechanisms rather than force.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use UN Peace Observation Commission where possible
rubrics_metrics.description: "The possibilities in the use of the United-Nations Peace Observation Commission."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fourth principle: consider UN observation/peacekeeping mechanisms as tools to reduce tensions and supervise cease-fires or agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek cease-fire followed by long-range negotiated settlement
rubrics_metrics.description: The resolution "expressed a hope that a cease-fire could be arranged between Nationalist and Communist China, followed by 'a serious effort to reach longrange agreement on the status and position of Formosa in relation to the mainland of China in the framework of the total world situation.'"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outcome-oriented recommendation: immediate de-escalation (cease-fire) leading into comprehensive negotiations on political status within a broader international framework.
